path.id: Since 2006, Hamsalekha has defined standard-setting event production. Explore our six core capabilities engineered for Bangalore's most prestigious cultural, wedding, and enterprise assemblies.
Setting the Mood, Commanding the Room

Exceptional lighting is the heartbeat of visual dramaturgy. Our state-of-the-art inventory of intelligent lighting fixtures is curated to sculpt dimensions, paint atmospheres, and coordinate perfectly with every critical cue of your itinerary.
Premium PAR-64 LEDs, high-output beam moving heads, and profile spots
Architectural building washes and elegant foliage lighting profiles
Professional Avolites & grandMA control consoles for zero-latency execution
Experienced lighting designers to draft custom pre-visualization scenes

Power is the silent foundation of event success. We guarantee bulletproof uptime with India's most modern fleet of soundproof green generator sets and robust, certified cabling. No brownouts, no sound interference, just flawless energy.
Eco-friendly, ultra-silent diesel gensets ranging from 125kVA to 500kVA
Dual-redundant AMF panels with auto-synchronized power backup loops
Heavy-duty weatherproof distribution boards and heavy-gauge copper wiring
On-site certified electrical engineers monitoring load distributions in real-time

Elevate your stage sets with confidence. Our heavy-duty load-tested aluminum trussing and rigging solutions are certified to safely suspend massive visual arrays, grand flower chandeliers, and custom overhead artwork.
High-grade international standard silver and black box aluminum trussing
Ground support towers, goalposts, circular trusses, and roof canopy systems
Certified overhead hoist motor rigs and safety arrest systems
Wind-load and structural integrity analysis before every assembly

We furnish your events with curation that elevates social interactions. From hand-crafted velvet lounges to mid-century modern dining tables, our furniture collection is maintained in pristine showroom condition.
Signature wedding Maharaja chairs, luxury chesterfields, and plush diwan sets
Contemporary bar counters, high bar stools, and boutique cocktail tables
Fine-dining wooden banquet tables with premium upholstery
Custom-styled VIP lounge setups matching the floral color palettes
The Details That Define Your Aesthetic

Our artisans combine rich Indian craftsmanship with contemporary design to deliver magnificent floral walls, high-art fabric drapes, and customized theme mockups that instantly transport guests into another world.
Spectacular floral setups using freshly imported and local blossoms
Exquisite tadelakt, plaster-finish, and grand wood-paneled backdrops
Bespoke themed props, antique brass artifacts, and modern mirror features
Premium chiffon, velvet, and raw silk drapery panels

For complex assemblies requiring multi-layered synchronization, our production command handles the technical direction. We seamlessly stitch lighting, structures, stagecraft, and scheduling into one unified masterpiece.
End-to-end technical production blueprints and floorplan layouts
Dedicated Stage Managers coordinating cues with vendors and performance artists
Integrated cue-sheets, AV, and power schematics for seamless handoffs
Rigorous post-event teardown and site restoration management
No matter the scale, we deliver bulletproof execution. We specialize in producing grand assemblies across corporate, social, and cultural sectors.
Based proudly in Bangalore, our production footprint spans across India's most coveted luxury event destinations. Wherever your milestone takes you, our heavy fleets follow.
Our primary hub with over 30,000 sq.ft. of advanced AV, staging, and generator warehousing.
Specialized beachside production kits engineered to resist seaside weather conditions.
Premium corporate setups and multi-day convention center lighting arrays.
Destination temple style wedding backdrops and tropical resort packages.
Get in touch with our design studio today for custom technical blueprints, load capacities, and inventory lease quotes tailored to your upcoming event scale.
Crafting extraordinary events since 2006. Premium lighting, power, and production.
Privacy Policy Â· Terms of Service

image.data-name: Subject: Grand stage of a premium Indian wedding with magnificent architectural trussing Action: Glowing dynamic laser beams sweeping across the venue with flawless event production Setting / Scene: Luxurious indoor wedding venue in Bangalore with warm ambient golden lighting Style / Medium: High-resolution professional event photography Lighting / Color: Warm golden ambient lighting contrasted with vibrant dynamic laser beams Perspective: Wide-angle view capturing the grandeur of the stage and production setup Camera Lens: 24mm f/2.8 wide-angle lens Aspect Ratio: 16:9.jpg

Professional event photography of a spectacular concert stage lighting set up, illuminating a high-end luxury ballroom with warm amber spotlights, dynamic laser beams, and atmospheric haze, eye-level wide shot, 24mm wide-angle lens, f/2.8, warm amber spotlights, vibrant laser beams, moody atmospheric haze, high contrast, 4:3 aspect ratio..jpg

Subject: A row of professional clean soundproof industrial power generators Action: Parked discretely behind an event structure with organized cabling Setting / Scene: Behind a high-end luxury event venue outdoors during late afternoon Style / Medium: Professional architectural photography Lighting / Color: Soft natural daylight, clean metallic and neutral industrial tones Perspective: Medium shot at eye level Camera Lens: 35mm lens Aspect Ratio: 4:3.jpg

Subject: Modern aluminum geometric trussing structure; Action: Assembled; Setting / Scene: Inside a high-ceiling luxury exhibition hall, professional rigging; Style / Medium: Professional event production photography, crisp details; Lighting / Color: Bright, clean architectural lighting with metallic silver highlights and subtle shadows; Perspective: Eye-level medium shot; Camera Lens: 35mm lens; Aspect Ratio: 4:3.jpg

Professional interior and event photography of an extravagantly styled wedding VIP lounge featuring gold accent furniture, plush emerald green velvet sofas, and a magnificent floral backdrop wall. Warm, elegant accent lighting highlights gold trims and rich emerald greens. Eye-level interior shot, centered composition, captured with a 35mm lens..jpg

Professional event photography of an Indian sangeet stage backdrop styled with cascading marigolds, premium heavy silk drapes, and antique brass lanterns, set in a luxury Indian wedding venue event production stage, warm ambient lighting, rich marigold gold tones, deep jewel-toned silks, and soft candle glow, front-facing eye-level wide shot, 35mm DSLR lens, high-end interior and stage design. --ar 4:3.jpg

Professional production directors table overlooking a grand Indian wedding reception, monitors showing lighting presets, stage in background, professional event photography, atmospheric stage lighting, glowing computer monitors, warm ambient room tones, medium shot from behind the production desk, 35mm lens, f/2.8, 16:9 aspect ratio.jpg

Professional event photography of premium stage backdrop silhouettes, illuminating a luxury event space with dramatic lighting in a high-end luxury event venue with atmospheric haze and elegant stage architecture. Warm amber spotlights, soft volumetric glow, sophisticated dark luxury tones. Wide-angle architectural view looking towards the stage, captured with a 24mm f/2.8 wide lens..jpg
